title: Superuser login role: labdb
description: Role 'labdb' has SUPERUSER + LOGIN. All-privilege role used for application access.
recommendation: Create a least-privilege role: REVOKE SUPERUSER FROM labdb;

title: SSL not enabled
description: PostgreSQL SSL is off. All connections are unencrypted.
recommendation: Set ssl=on in postgresql.conf and restart.
